numberPlan.countingModel: one item per bookmark shape; ten marked tabs per pack

bookmark-reading-corner.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one original square atlas with strictly equal four independent cells in a precise 2 by 2 arrangement, no separators, no gutters, nothing crosses the horizontal or vertical midline. The four cells serve a Chinese grade-one math course set at a community reading corner where children pack paper bookmarks. Fine natural cream paper grain, warm matte gouache, clean rounded cut-paper outlines, muted pine green, apricot, warm cream, small persimmon accents. Consistent professional picture-book art. No text, letters, numerals, math, labels, quantities to count, barcodes or watermarks. Upper-left cell for the first start card: a Chinese first-grade girl and boy at a library bookmark craft table. One child offers a single unmarked cream envelope while the other holds one colorful paper bookmark. Expressions gentle and focused. Place faces and hands within the middle band of the square so a wide crop retains the action. Upper-right cell for a falling tile game background: a quiet overhead view of a cream honey-oak craft table, with faint forest green bookcase trim and muted apricot props only at the outer edges, unobstructed low-contrast central 85 percent. Bottom-left cell for the second start card: a small deep green hand trolley with one closed cream parcel beside a friendly Chinese first-grade child in front of low library cubbies. Keep the trolley, carton and face close together in the middle horizontal band. Bottom-right cell for a grid delivery game background: very open, light wood library workroom floor, empty calm middle 85 percent, hints of low pine shelving along the upper and far outer edges, overhead view, softly lit. All four cells should have separate usable compositions and no typography.

bookmark-workroom-sprites.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Make one square 2×2 transparent sprite atlas for the same warm paper storybook library and bookmark-packing activity. Exactly four equal cells, broad transparent margins, no visible cell borders and no item touching or crossing the edges. Genuine alpha background throughout. Rounded matte gouache and cut-paper, subtle paper grain, rich pine green, cream highlights and small apricot accents. No words, numerals, labels, shadows, ground or checkerboard. Upper-left: single empty small pine-green low library hand trolley in three-quarter side view, facing right, clearly visible wheels and handle, sitting level. Upper-right: the same empty trolley, same silhouette, color, view and scale, leaning just a few degrees forward to suggest pushing motion, wheels still readable. Lower-left: one cream paper bookmark shaped sticker, rounded corners, single apricot botanical motif and short tassel, no lettering, thick outline readable at small size. Lower-right: one cheerful closed cream parcel shaped completion sticker with a pine-green ribbon, defined orange paper-cut outline, no lettering or symbols. Keep each object in its own cell centered in the middle 65 percent. No people or additional props in this transparent sheet.
